title: Powell Industries, Inc. fiscal 2025 Form 10-K
excerpt: Powell reports one operating segment, sells custom-engineered electrical distribution and control systems, and had no customer above 10% of consolidated fiscal-2025 revenue.
summary: The annual filing defines Powell's products, end markets, customer and project concentration, competitive set, fixed-price contract risks, input and labor constraints, backlog limitations, capacity investments and debt-free balance-sheet context.
